caption: The drawing depicts a tall, vertical wooden post with a rough, natural texture standing upright on a solid, irregularly-shaped wooden base. Attached to the post at about one-third from the top is a horizontal wooden arm, which is connected to a vertical support clamped around the post. Resting on this support is a small, black metal candleholder containing a white candle. A thin rod or peg protrudes horizontally from one side of the arm. The overall color palette consists primarily of various shades of brown and ochre for the wood, with subtle strokes indicating wood grain and texture, while the candleholder is rendered in black and the candle in white. The composition is centered on the page, with an additional small, simplified line drawing of the same object placed in the upper left corner within a rectangular box. The background is empty and off-white, emphasizing the object.
title: Candle Stand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
